Section 23. Protection of drinking water sources against contamination. Section 24. District Authority to be assisted by Panchayat. Section 25. Declaration of water scarcity area. Section 26. Establishment, constitution and incorporation of the Watershed Water Resources Committee. Section 30. Groundwater management for existing users of groundwater. Section 31. Assistance in preparation of Integrated Watershed Development and Management Plan. Section 45. Technical survey and supporting work. Section 46. Bar to claim compensation. Section 52. Offences and penalties. Section 53. Offences by companies. Section 54. Compounding of offences. Section 55. Cognizance and trial of offences. Section 56. Appeals. Section 57. Power of Government to make Rules. Section 58. Power to remove difficulties. Section 59. Repeal and saving.
